Title: Hydroponic Cilantro: pH, EC, Light & Bolting Guide
Description: Grow hydroponic cilantro at pH 5.5–6.0, EC 1.2–2.0 and 64–81 °F. Harvest about 7 weeks from seed, before long days and heat make it bolt. Free guide from HydroRigor, with figures from university and extension research.
Keywords: hydroponic cilantro, hydroponics, indoor gardening, grow vegetables indoors
